purpose: Teach: 洗浄/貸付/清算/通商/投機/知名度/推計/税込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、工場の洗浄を自ら確認されたぞ
lines.en: Your father made it his business to oversee the factory cleaning himself.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. Light emphasis on 'himself'—pride in the detail. Steady pace, the voice of someone looking back across decades with clear sight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員への貸付に寛容でした
lines.en: He did. He was generous with the workers when they needed to borrow.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Soft but certain. The cadence of a son speaking about his father—no performance, just truth offered plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、清算には誠実にお向き合いだった
lines.en: Your father faced every debt with integrity. He didn't dodge it.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. A pause before 'integrity'—weighing the word. Slow delivery, as though each phrase is a small stone placed carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは通商の流れを読まれた
lines.en: He did. He had a mind for reading the market—understanding where things were heading.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. No grandeur. The tone of someone working through a memory, finding the right word. Slight lift at 'heading.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、投機ではなく堅実な経営を貫いたぞ
lines.en: Your father built solid business. He didn't chase quick gains. He stayed true to that.
lines.style: Firmer now, conviction underneath. A light weight on 'solid'—not boasting, stating fact. The voice of someone defending a legacy, quietly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会社の知名度を確実に上げられた
lines.en: He did. He built the company's standing steadily, year after year. It was reliable growth.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. A slight lean into 'steadily'—emphasizing the patience in it. Measured, the voice of someone who understood that work and is glad his father did too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業績を慎重に推計されたぞ
lines.en: Your father was careful with how he reported the numbers. He thought them through.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation. Slight emphasis on 'careful'—the kind of care that doesn't make headlines. Slow, thoughtful pace. A small trailing-off that says 'and that mattered.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは税込み価格表示を徹底されました
lines.en: He did. He insisted on showing the true price to customers—no hiding the cost. That was his way.
lines.style: Firm, almost tender. A light stress on 'true'—this was a principle. The closing words slow slightly, a quiet period at the end of something being said that needed saying.
